size_basis: storage-sizing box (node size_mm, AQS-DUTY-064); the duty section 2 shell line 600 x 400 x 800 predates it (WORK_ORDER W12)
holdup_basis: the duty section 2 holdup basis (7 days of throughput at the 10 L/d potable tap = 0.0700 m3) sets the working level z 520.4 (A-VES: the duty already carries a holdup basis, so the model level is set by it and reported; not turned into a new residence-time claim)

tank.wall_basis: study fab-page polymer wall (10 mm); no thickness booked on the node (WORK_ORDER W12)

internals.source: none: the node internals row is none; the pumps and UV are purchased equipment envelopes on the skid, not node internals
internals.basis: no internal solid drawn; purchased internals stay with the maker (WORK_ORDER W12)

purchased.basis: plan rule 6: purchased items are named as purchased, drawn as their envelope and interface; the node design block names them
purchased.metering_pumps: 2 x metering diaphragm (Ca slurry, MgCl2) - node design block; envelope 110 x 90 x 130 each; drive rating with the maker TDS at order
purchased.uv_unit: UV unit after the dose (potable integrity) - node design block; envelope OD 90 x 220 long on the tray front-left; lamp rating with the maker TDS at order

material.basis: duty section 3: PVC-U or HDPE per AQS-STD-002 rule M1; PVC-U drawn, the HDPE alternative is a named hold (WORK_ORDER W12); corrosion allowance does not apply to the polymer
